# #24 Reactions — blind adversarial QA

**Verdict: PASS** (no blocker/major). 3 minor + 2 cosmetic/info findings below.
Tested 2026-10-10 against a throwaway stack (`scripts/lib/stack.sh run`, backend :38543, vite :37713), REST via
`.verify/qa/24/rest.mjs` (out: `rest.out`), MCP via both servers with the SDK client (`mcp.out`), real Chromium
through `scripts/lib/browser-slot.sh` (`ui.mjs`/`ui2.mjs`/`ui3.mjs`, outputs `ui*.out`). Implementation not read.
Not reported per brief: CJK heading `日本語の見出し` gets an empty id from today's ASCII slugger (#3), so it has no
trigger; the bar sits under the scrolling pane until #5.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC-24.1 PASS — toggle twice: `active:true`, +1 count 1, names ["Ana"]; then `active:false`, doc `[]`.
- AC-24.2 PASS — `on:true` x2 count 1; `on:false` x2 absent.
- AC-24.3 PASS — `thumbsup` 400 `invalid_reaction` "Unknown reaction"; `a b` 400; reader `x` 400.
- AC-24.4 PASS — count 3, names ["Bo","Ana"] (most recent first), anonymous 1, mine true.
- AC-24.5 PASS — protected doc (PUT w/o token 401), reaction 200; also in UI as a viewer, no toast.
- AC-24.6 PASS — expired GET/POST 410; DELETE 204, re-created same slug → total 0. Unknown doc 404/404.
- AC-24.7 PASS — click 👍: aria-pressed=true, count 1; after reload still pressed/1 (`desktop-bar-after-click.png`).
- AC-24.8 PASS — 390x844 touch: trigger opacity 1, tap → picker, tap 👀 → chip "👀1" (`phone-picker.png`, `phone-chip.png`).
- AC-24.9 PASS — stranger "Ana and 2 others"; anon reader "You, Ana and 1 other"; Ana herself "You and 2 others" (`desktop-who-tooltip.png`).
- AC-24.10 PASS — aborted POST: optimistic pressed, reverts, `app-toast[data-toast=reaction-failed]` role=alert kind=error (`desktop-failure-toast.png`); HTTP 500 also reverts.
- AC-24.11 PASS — heading renamed via PUT: live chip gone within one poll and after reload; GET still has `rollout-plan`.
- AC-24.12 PASS — HTTP and stdio servers expose `get_reactions` (only new tool), emoji-keyed `doc`, `sections` sorted by total desc; unknown doc → tool error "Session not found".
- AC-24.13 PASS — bar border/text vs background in all 6 themes ≥ 5.2:1 (dark 6.79, locus-dark 17.6); focus ring 2px solid, ≥ 3.39:1 (`theme-*-bar-focus.png`).
- AC-24.14 PASS — 10 Tabs reach "React to section Rollout plan", opacity 1 once the fade finishes, 2px outline; Enter opens picker (focus on first option), Enter adds chip, Esc closes, focus back on trigger. Triple-click selection = "Rollout plan" (`desktop-trigger-focused.png`, `desktop-picker-open.png`).

## Edge cases (all PASS unless listed as defect)
Rapid 7 clicks and 3 clicks at 700 ms latency converge on the server (on, count 1); 21 parallel REST toggles → count ≤ 1.
Duplicate headings: reaction on 2nd "Intro" stored as `intro-1`, chip only there. Emoji heading `launch-day`, h3
`risks-mitigations` OK; h1/h4 have no trigger. Unicode section ids (CJK, `café-über_1`) accepted, emoji/201 chars 400.
Blocked localStorage (getter throws): reactions on/off and section reaction work, no page errors. Name change replaces
name; name trimmed to 80; same name from 2 readers listed once. 1000 reactions: GET max 2.0 ms, names capped at 20 with
exact count. Embed `?embed=1`: no bar, no triggers. HTML doc: bar present, doc reaction stored, no triggers in page or
iframe. Review and publish mode both show the bar. Tablet 820 and 1050 px (mouse): triggers always visible. Phone: no
horizontal scroll; long-press on doc button shows "Ana" and does not toggle; long-press chip shows "You". Refresh: GET
/reactions fires together with the doc poll every 5 s, no extra loop; remote reaction visible in ~5 s. `reader_id` =
`anon-<uuid>`; reviewer name sent. Chips/trigger `user-select:none`; TOC text clean. Library `reaction_count` = total.

## Defects
1. **minor — section id `__proto__` is accepted, stored and counted, but invisible.** `POST {code:'+1', section:'__proto__', reader_id:'r-aaaaaaaa'}` → 200; GET `sections` has no `__proto__` key (it is assigned onto a plain object's prototype), MCP omits it too, yet `total` includes it (doc total 11 vs 10 visible). `section:'constructor'` works. Either reject it or build `sections` with a null-prototype map. Evidence `rest.out`.
2. **minor — picker focus order.** The picker is not next to its trigger in tab order: Tab past the last option goes to BODY and then the header (`app-home-link`), and the picker **stays open** (DECISIONS #24 says it closes when focus leaves). Shift+Tab from the first option lands on the *previous* heading's trigger, not the one that opened it. Evidence `ui3.out`. (WCAG 2.4.3)
3. **minor — section trigger icon is 2.88:1 against the background in the default dark theme** (rgb(110,106,101) on rgb(36,36,40)); below 3:1 for a control's only visual (WCAG 1.4.11). Other themes 3.37–9.7. AC-24.13 covers only the bar, so the AC itself passes. Evidence `ui2.out`, `theme-dark-heading-trigger-focused.png`.
4. cosmetic — after a long-press is released the `reaction-who` tooltip stays visible until the next tap elsewhere (`phone-longpress.png`).
5. info — who-reacted names are not available to keyboard users: focusing a button shows no `reaction-who`, and the aria-label holds the emoji name and count only. The spec asks only for hover/long-press. Also `name: 42` (non-string) is accepted as anonymous rather than rejected with 400.
